topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: The trees stand closer now, casting long shadows where once the light was free. My steps are slow, each paw treading softly on the earth that knows my weight. The scent of ripe berries lingers, but the urge to feast is muted. The air tastes thin, and the usual rustle of the forest seems quieter, more distant. I find myself listening for something I cannot name, a note lost in the breeze. Even the call of the distant hawk carries a different tone, a hollow echo. I move on, the path ahead less clear, each step a question, the world around a vast, unspoken silence.
